concerns.text: The Constitution Check claims that citations are drawn from a “Verified datasets” block, but the plan does not contain any such block. This violates Principle II (Verified Accuracy) of the constitution.
The data‑model defines an `analysis_output` schema (analysis_output.schema.yaml) but the plan never references or exercises this contract; no phase produces an artifact matching that schema.

The data‑model includes a `dataset` schema (dataset.schema.yaml) for a raw combined BFI‑2 + listening dataset, yet the plan only mentions separate raw BFI and raw music files and never creates or validates a combined dataset matching this schema.
The data‑model defines a `results` schema (results.schema.yaml) for coefficient‑delta CSVs, but the plan does not generate or validate such a file in any phase.

Phase 9 references validation of `processed_dataset.schema.yaml` only; it does not mention validation of the other contracts (`analysis_output.schema.yaml`, `dataset.schema.yaml`, `results.schema.yaml`) that exist in the contracts directory.

The correlation output is described as `results/correlation_matrix.csv`, but the contract file for this artifact is `correlation_results.schema.yaml` (defined in the data‑model, not in the contracts folder). The plan should explicitly reference the contract it validates.
Similarly, the regression output `results/regression_summary.csv` corresponds to `regression_results.schema.yaml` in the data‑model; the plan does not state that this contract will be exercised.
